params.text:
Community newsletter / Issue 04. This edition records the decisions from the neighbourhood workshop. The purpose is to explain what was agreed, who owns the next action, and where residents can send corrections. The editor checks every date against the meeting notes before the issue is sent for review.
Public garden. The team will retain the existing trees and test a small planting bed near the south entrance. Volunteers will survey sunlight during the morning and afternoon. No construction date is confirmed. A drawing and a maintenance estimate will be circulated before any permanent work is approved.
Library programme. The reading group meets on the first Saturday of the month. The librarian will publish the final room booking and capacity on the noticeboard. Families can request an accessible copy of the programme. Names and photographs will be published only after the relevant permission has been confirmed.
Walking route. Residents identified two crossings that need a clearer sight line. The transport working group will document the location, take photographs from a safe public position, and send a short evidence note to the council. This newsletter records the request; it does not describe it as approved road work.
Budget update. The treasurer is comparing the lighting and printing estimates with the available balance. Proposed purchases remain separate from committed spending. The next update will give the approved amount, supplier and decision date. Readers should report a suspected error before the final proof deadline.
Volunteer briefing. New participants should contact the coordinator before the event, explain any access needs, and choose a task appropriate to their availability. The coordinator will share the meeting point and emergency contact privately. Personal telephone numbers are excluded from the public edition.
Corrections and follow-up. Send a correction with the section title, the disputed statement and a supporting source. The editor will record the change in the next issue. Questions without a confirmed answer will remain labelled as open items. The review copy is intended for factual checking before distribution.
Editorial close. Review the headline, each section transition and the final paragraph after text reflows. A continued article must keep its original paragraph order across pages. The final PDF is a proof; the editable project and IDML are retained so that a later correction does not require rebuilding the layout.

check: 正文全文逐字一致；两页文本框共享故事且顺序正确；两框均三栏；正文样式真实应用；最终无溢出。
boundary: 示例是两页三栏续文，不提供真实图片环绕、自动页码、跨栏标题或脚注迁移的已验收保证。复杂注释须另查支持和数量。
